missing_runtime_importance.description: Whether the code is critical to system operation
missing_runtime_importance.collection_method: Dependency fan-in analysis, API endpoint mapping

missing_failure_history.description: Whether the code has caused bugs or incidents

missing_ownership_evidence.description: Who is responsible for this code

missing_indirect_test_evidence.description: Whether the code is exercised by integration tests
missing_indirect_test_evidence.collection_method: Test coverage analysis, import graph analysis

missing_change_frequency.description: How often the file is modified

missing_complexity_decomposition.description: Whether the module has too many responsibilities

missing_behavioral_evidence.description: Whether the observation actually causes problems
missing_behavioral_evidence.collection_method: Requires human judgment or runtime data

enrichment_priority.rationale: Determines whether code is critical to system
Historical failures are strong actionability signal
Unowned code may be less actionable
Indirect coverage may make 'no test' less actionable
Helps determine if size is actually problematic
Requires human judgment, cannot be fully automated
